The saltwater crocodile grows bigger than the Nile crocodile, reaching up to 5–6 meters in length, while the Nile crocodile reaches up to 16 meters in length.

st-boar-factbook-001.text:
Not found in this phone's offline library. From the model's memory, may be wrong:
Kyrgyzstan's capital is Bishkek, it has a population of approximately 900,000, and the country is highly mountainous with rugged terrain.

st-boar-factbook-004.text: Thimphu is the capital of Bhutan and is named after the surrounding valley and dzongkhag [1]. Bhutan has about 700,000 people [2]. The name comes from the surrounding valley, with a legend about a king who ruled there.

st-boar-factbook-007.text: Paraguay gets nearly all its power from dams, and it uses the Paraguayan currency, the guaraní. Its main exports are soybeans and beef [2].

st-boar-factbook-011.text: Western Sahara is currently controlled by Morocco, as recognized by over 82 countries [1]. The planned independence vote never occurred because the region was transferred to Morocco in 1975 due to Spain's instability and Morocco's military aggression, leading to a legal status as a Spanish colony that requires decolonization.

st-boar-medlineplus-en-013.text: Doctors most often see ventricular tachycardia, which is detected through an electrocardiogram (ECG) [1].

st-boar-simplewiki-en-016.text: Disney achieved the first animated feature film with a 3D animated opening crawl and the first live-action/animated musical. The film faced criticism for its portrayal of the character of the dog, which some felt was too stereotypical.

st-qa-bitcoin-se-018.text: Hardened derivation is required for both the spend and scan keys in BIP32/BIP44 to ensure security [1]. It is typically applied to the second level of the key tree, ensuring that only the master key can be derived, while derived keys are protected. This is specified in BIP32 and BIP44 [2].

st-qa-cooking-se-007.text: Store green onions in a cool, dry place, such as a mesh bin or a container with holes, to allow air circulation. Avoid storing them in the fridge, as moisture can cause wilting. Use them as soon as possible after harvesting.

st-qa-ethereum-se-002.text: The ENS name renewal process is automatic once the expiration date is reached. You'll receive a renewal notice, and you can renew it before the expiration date to avoid loss. The registrar handles the renewal, so you don't need to take any action.

st-qa-money-se-012.text: No, earning additional pounds over the higher-rate threshold does not double your total income tax bill. The higher-rate threshold applies to income above £50,000, and any additional income beyond that is taxed at 40% rather than 32.5%.

st-qa-money-se-013.text: No, the expense ratio of a target-date fund is typically charged on top of the underlying funds' ratios.

st-qa-outdoors-se-009.text: Static ropes are typically chosen when climbing in environments where friction is important, such as in tight spaces or when using technical climbing techniques, as they provide better control and less slippage.

st-qa-outdoors-se-020.text: Sleeping under the stars without a tent in the Austrian mountains is not allowed due to strict regulations. Visitors are prohibited from leaving marked paths, starting fires, or camping outside designated areas [1]. The rules aim to protect the natural environment and ensure safety.

st-qa-travel-se-006.text: Take the Gatwick Express to London Victoria Station, then take the London Underground Piccadilly Line to Paddington Station [1]. Luggage can be carried through underground stations [1].

st-qa-travel-se-010.text: You cannot turn euro notes into coins for parking meters in Italy. Parking meters require coins or electronic payments, and euro notes are not accepted. You should use real coins or a mobile payment method.

st-qa-travel-se-012.text: VAT back is possible for electronics purchased from Amazon UK, but the eligibility depends on your country's tax laws and the specific items. You'll need to check the VAT refund process for Ireland.

st-qa-travel-se-018.text:
Not found in this phone's offline library. From the model's memory, may be wrong:
In Sweden, using a Romanian SIM card for EU roaming is possible, but it may incur extra charges. The SIM must be compatible with Sweden's network, and roaming costs may apply. Check with your provider for specific details.

vit-cry-006.text:
Not found in this phone's offline library. From the model's memory, may be wrong:
Quadratic funding is a method of fundraising where individuals or organizations donate to a cause, and the amount donated is proportional to the square of the number of people who have donated. Its main weakness is that it can lead to collusion, as donors can influence the outcome by bribing others to donate.

vit-cry-007.text: D/acc is a digital-to-analog converter, which converts digital code to an analog signal [1]. It is the reverse of an analog-to-digital converter (ADC) [1].

vit-hum-004.text: Gríma Wormtongue kills Saruman in Isegard, and later is shot by hobbit archers [2].

lan-ref-002.text: The Union won the American Civil War [4]. The Confederacy was eventually defeated, leading to the abolition of slavery and the reunification of the United States.

lan-cmp-003.text: India is the seventh-largest country by area [1]. Several countries are bigger than India by area, including Bangladesh, Myanmar, and Thailand.

st-boar-factbook-013.text: Trinidad and Tobago gained independence from the United Kingdom on August 31, 1962 [1]. The country's economy has been dominated by the fishing and tourism industries for more than a century.

st-boar-medlineplus-en-020.text: Vaccines generally have mild side effects, and serious side effects are very rare [2]. There is no link between vaccines and autism; the belief that vaccines cause autism is a misconception [2].

st-boar-simplewiki-en-007.text: In 793, Vikings raided Lindisfarne, destroying the monastery and stealing the Lindisfarne Gospels [1]. The monks eventually moved Saint Cuthbert's remains to Durham Cathedral [6].

lan-exp-003.text: Kenya is in East Africa, near the Horn of Africa, and its capital is Nairobi [3]. The official languages are English and Swahili, and Kenya gained independence in 1963.

st-qa-outdoors-se-008.text: A nor'easter is named because the storm's winds come from the northeast, not the southwest [2]. The name refers to the direction of the wind, not the storm's path.

st-boar-medlineplus-en-007.text: The CDC advises pregnant women not to travel to areas with a Zika outbreak, as the virus can be transmitted to the fetus [2]. The risk includes potential birth defects and other health issues. Always follow local health advisories.

st-boar-simplewiki-en-003.text: Cosmogony focuses on the origin of the universe, while cosmology studies the universe in general [2]. Science cannot describe the first instant of the universe due to the lack of a testable theory of quantum gravity.

st-boar-simplewiki-en-015.text: The name "Google" is a play on the word "googol," which refers to the number 10^100 [1]. Google earns money by showing advertisements to users who click on them, using data to target ads to the right people [3].

st-qa-bitcoin-se-005.text: Bitcoin Core is a full node that requires significant resources and is not designed to mine coins. It will not earn you coins on its own. You need a mining pool or a dedicated mining rig for that purpose.

st-qa-outdoors-se-014.text: A triangular head is not a reliable way to determine if a snake is venomous, as many non-venomous snakes also have triangular heads. Viper species, which are venomous, have triangular heads, but this trait is not exclusive to venomous snakes. [2]

st-boar-factbook-010.text: Hong Kong's economy is driven by finance, trade, and services, with the financial sector being a major contributor [3]. The Hong Kong dollar is currently worth approximately HK$7.80 per US dollar [2].

st-qa-bitcoin-se-015.text: An ASIC miner is a specialized computer chip designed for Bitcoin mining [2]. It beats a regular computer because it is highly efficient at performing the specific computational tasks required for mining, such as hashing blocks. This makes ASIC miners much faster and more energy-efficient compared to general-purpose computers.

st-qa-travel-se-016.text: Get enough sleep before departure, stay hydrated, and avoid heavy meals. Once in Beirut, adjust your sleep schedule gradually and stay in a bright, consistent light environment to help your body adjust to the new time zone.

st-qa-bitcoin-se-013.text: A lightweight SPV wallet verifies payments by checking block headers and transaction hashes, without downloading the entire blockchain [2]. It trusts full nodes to ensure accuracy, while a full node validates every transaction locally.

st-qa-money-se-018.text: Leasing a car offers convenience and lower upfront costs, but you don't build equity. Buying a car gives you ownership and long-term savings, though it requires a larger initial payment.

st-qa-travel-se-015.text: Keep your camera and lenses in a protective case, use a shoulder strap for comfort, and carry them in a breathable bag to avoid heat damage.

st-boar-medlineplus-en-019.text: Keep your emergency kit, flashlights, and blankets ready. Stay informed about road conditions and avoid driving in severe weather [2].

st-qa-outdoors-se-005.text: No, drinkable liquor should not be used to clean wounds. It can cause irritation and damage to the skin and tissues. Instead, use clean water or a saline solution.
